remarks:
Welcome to the Farmhouse! A rare opportunity to own a truly special piece of New England-inspired country living. This beautifully renovated 1800s farmhouse blends timeless character with modern comfort on 82.15 spectacular acres featuring two pristine, private ponds, over 1,200 feet of road frontage, a wonderful mix of open, prime hay fields and wooded land, and maintained access roads throughout. Perched overlooking the property is a charming 550 sq ft summer house with a woodstove and stone hearth—an idyllic retreat in every season.

The farmhouse has been thoughtfully transformed while preserving its distinct historic style. A stamped concrete, covered porch with a hot tub leads you into a formal foyer, or enter through the convenient mudroom/laundry area. A charming first-floor bath features a beautifully refurbished wood-trimmed tub. The first-floor primary suite is exceptional, with a walk-in closet, dressing area, a bath with heated floors, tub, and walk-in shower. 

The chef's kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring a butler's working pantry and open-concept family and dining areas, all enhanced by radiant floor heat, a gas fireplace, and windows galore. A spacious living room offers a cozy woodstove, while the formal dining room showcases original hardwood floors and built-in cabinetry. Upstairs are two generous bedrooms, a craft room, and abundant storage.

Outside, the improvements continue with an immaculate 4-stall barn with new metal siding and roof—ideal for horses, animals, hobbies, or your own vision. A 1,500 sq ft machine shed provides storage and could easily serve as a garage.

The land is the true standout, with room for recreation, gardening, horses, alpacas, hunting, fishing, hiking, or simply enjoying the peace of this country setting. A remarkable property where history, modern amenities, and natural beauty come together. Dog Lover? Approximately 30 acres have invisible fencing!

It's centrally located, convenient to Rte 219, and an easy ride south to Ellicottville with its attractions, or a less stressful 40-minute commute to Buffalo. Property is also listed under Lots, Vacant Land and Farms, see MLS # B1716136
